title: Oxford Economics Acquires FrontierView
author: Keith Mason
text:
NEWS

28 Aug 2026

Oxford Economics Acquires FrontierView 

Oxford Economics has acquired FrontierView, a premier strategic insights firm providing market monitoring, industry data, and executive advisory services to corporate decision-makers worldwide.

Founded in 2008 (originally as Frontier Strategy Group), FrontierView helps global business leaders evaluate market conditions, inform strategic planning, and drive international expansion, with specialist depth in healthcare alongside its broader corporate advisory work. 

“This acquisition is about unlocking the power of economics to drive real strategic advantage for our clients,” said Innes McFee, Chief Executive Officer of Oxford Economics. “By bringing together FrontierView’s strategic insights with our macroeconomic foundation, we’re giving our clients a more complete offering to inform strategy and drive growth in an increasingly complex world.” 

Together, the two firms bring clients a rare combination: rigorous, globally consistent macroeconomic forecasting, paired with senior, advisory-led insight that translates directly into C-suite decision-making. Clients gain a single, joined-up view rather than needing to piece macro and strategic insight together from separate sources, backed by a deeper bench of research and a broader global network than either firm offered alone. 

We see this as a natural fit, one that strengthens our advisory capability and deepens our ability to support corporate clients making high-stakes strategic decisions, particularly in healthcare, where this acquisition gives us genuine, specialist depth for the first time. 

If you have any questions or would like to learn more, please feel free to contact us.  

About FrontierView

FrontierView is a premier strategic insights firm providing market monitoring, industry data, and executive advisory services. Founded in 2008 FrontierView supports corporate decision-makers in navigating international growth, market entry, and strategic planning.

About Oxford Economics

Oxford Economics is the world’s foremost independent economic advisory firm. Covering over 200 countries, 100 industrial sectors, and 8,000 cities and regions, we provide rigorous economic analysis and forecasting to empower leaders to make faster, more confident decisions in an uncertain world.
